verdict.rationale: Anytype exposes a local gRPC/HTTP API and CLI documented at developers.anytype.io, plus example integrations (MCP server, AI agent scripts) that developers can build against, and GitHub notes it is 'extensible through a gRPC API and AI Agents.' However, this is an integration/automation API rather than a dedicated plugin architecture or SDK, there's no found OpenAPI/reference spec (probe returned 404s for standard OpenAPI paths), and no plugin marketplace or plugin-specific developer guide is evidenced. missing for 10: a formal plugin SDK/plugin system (vs. general API), a discoverable OpenAPI/reference spec, and independent developer confirmation of building plugins.
